primitives.name: Inverse-Distance Valuation Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: A MAN'S VALUE TO HIS TEAM VARIES IN-VERSELY AS HIS DISTANCE FROM THE BALL.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: V_i: instantaneous tactical value (dimensionless utility), \mathbf{x}_i: agent position (meters), \mathbf{x}_{ball}: ball centroid (meters), \kappa: coupling constant (utility-meters^n), n: decay exponent (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Tactical influence decays monotonically with Euclidean distance; the ball acts as a singular attractor for team utility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur at \| \mathbf{x}_i - \mathbf{x}_{ball} \| \to 0 unless regularized; fails during off-ball systemic rotations where distant agents dictate structural integrity.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to gravitational or Coulombic potential fields in classical mechanics, mapping spatial geometry directly to discrete utility allocation.
layer2.telemetry: Expected points added per second (EPAS) normalized by player-to-ball distance.

primitives.name: Line Momentum Dominance Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: IF THE LINE GOES FORWARD THE TEAM WINS, IF THE LINE COMES BACKWARD THE TEAM LOSES.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \mathcal{W}: binary outcome indicator (dimensionless), \Theta: Heaviside step function, L: engagement boundary coordinate (meters), \dot{L}: boundary velocity (m/s), T: match duration (seconds).
primitives.assumptions: The macroscopic outcome is strictly determined by the time-integrated net displacement of the primary engagement boundary.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down in sports utilizing discrete scoring events that do not correlate linearly with continuous boundary displacement (e.g., pure shooting sports).

layer2.mapping: Maps to the terminal condition of a 1D stochastic differential equation governing the score differential or field-position advantage.
layer2.telemetry: Net yards gained / Expected points swing per play sequence.

primitives.name: Negative Feedback Energy Amplifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: IF THE GAME OR A BREAK GOES AGAINST YOU, DON'T LIE DOWN: PUT ON MORE STEAM.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \Delta E_{injected}: additional metabolic/effort expenditure (Joules), \delta S_{adversarial}: negative stochastic shock to state (dimensionless utility loss), \alpha: amplification coefficient (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Optimal control requires a non-linear, positive feedback response to negative stochastic shocks to maintain equilibrium.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System failure occurs if metabolic reserves are exhausted (E_max reached) before \alpha can compensate for a large \delta S_{adversarial}.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller applying aggressive corrective torque against a sudden external disturbance.
layer2.telemetry: High-intensity sprint volume (HIIT) immediately following opponent scoring drives.
